verdict.rationale: Cal.com is a scheduling platform, not an AI agent or client that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Cal.com publishes a hosted MCP server that external AI clients connect to. That server-side evidence belongs to a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
